$comment: THE CORRECTION LEDGER. Hand-maintained, never written by a generator. Each entry undoes one instance of the name-collision join artifact described in docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-018: a commune that was given a same-named commune's daira and/or postal code from a different wilaya. An entry is APPLIED to data/algeria.json by scripts/build-data.ts, and assertions A21-A24 fail the build if the data and this ledger ever disagree. Supplying a corrected value REQUIRES a source, exactly as it does for the reform table - see shared/contract/reform.md for the reasoning. postalCodeTo:null means WITHDRAWN: the shipped code provably belongs to another wilaya's commune, and no replacement has been sourced yet. That is not the same as the 27 communes that were published without a code at all.

corrections.source: fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sidi_Abderrahmane_(Tiaret) — wilaya Tiaret, daira Ain Kermes, code postal 14028, ONS 1438
corrections.note: Shipped under Tenes, which is a daira of 02 Chlef, with Chlef's postal code.

corrections.source: fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/El_Marsa_(Alger) and Liste des communes de la wilaya d'Alger — daira Dar El Beida, code postal 16111, ONS 1640. Alger officially has 13 dairas; El Marsa is not one of them.
corrections.note: Self-named phantom daira. Shipped with 02 Chlef's postal code.

corrections.source: fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hammamet_(Alger) and Daïras de la wilaya d'Alger — daira Cheraga, ONS 1624; Alger officially has 13 dairas and Bir Mokadem is a daira of 12 Tebessa. The same infobox gives code postal 16060, which is NOT written: our data already assigns 16060 to 16-bab-el-oued-rais-hamidou, and taking it would create the dataset's only postal code shared by two communes of the SAME wilaya. One of the two is wrong and a single infobox does not settle which, so the code is withdrawn pending a source.
corrections.note: Daira sourced and corrected; postal code WITHDRAWN rather than replaced. Resolving it means establishing whether 16060 belongs to Hammamet or to Rais Hamidou.
